dossier.purpose: QMD ('Query Markup Documents', npm package @tobilu/qmd) is a local search engine for collections of Markdown/plain-text files. `qmd collection add` registers a directory plus glob mask; `qmd update` copies each matching file's UTF-8 text into one SQLite index (content-addressed by SHA-256, FTS5 for BM25); `qmd embed` adds chunk embeddings (sqlite-vec). Retrieval modes are lexical (`qmd search`, no models), vector (`qmd vsearch`) and hybrid expansion + RRF + LLM rerank (`qmd query`), using three local GGUF models run through node-llama-cpp. Results carry docid, collection-relative path, title, score, line and snippet; the stored body is read back with `qmd get`/`multi-get` (CLI) or MCP `get`/`multi_get`. The same engine is exposed as a CLI, an MCP server (stdio or localhost HTTP, read-only tools) and a Node/Bun SDK. There is no converter for PDF, scans, Office, EPUB or HTML: only text files matched by the collection mask are ingested.

claims.claim: An on-device search engine for everything you need to remember. Index your markdown notes, meeting transcripts, documentation, and knowledge bases. Search with keywords or natural language. Ideal for your agentic flows.
QMD combines BM25 full-text search, vector semantic search, and LLM re-ranking, all running locally via node-llama-cpp with GGUF models.
Typed expansions are routed exclusively: lex goes to BM25/FTS, vec and hyde go to vector search. The original query is sent to both backends, then fused with RRF and reranked.
Three retrieval modes: `qmd search` (fast keyword, BM25 only), `qmd vsearch` (semantic), `qmd query` (hybrid + reranking, 'best quality').
Original-document read-back: `qmd get <path|#docid>` (also `--full`) and `qmd multi-get <glob|comma-list>`; get/multi-get are line-numbered by default and accept a `path:from:count` suffix.
Context descriptions attached to collections/paths are returned with matching documents; described as 'the key feature' of QMD.
MCP server exposes query, get, multi_get and status; stdio by default, optional HTTP transport (`qmd mcp --http [--daemon]`, localhost:8181).
Claude Code: install the plugin (`claude plugin marketplace add tobi/qmd`, `claude plugin install qmd@qmd`) or configure MCP manually; Claude Desktop JSON config is provided.
HTTP endpoints POST /mcp, POST /query (alias /search) and GET /health; Origin/Host validation guards against DNS rebinding; endpoints are unauthenticated.
SDK: createStore({dbPath, config|configPath}), search, searchLex, searchVector, get, getDocumentBody, multiGet, update, embed; the SDK requires an explicit dbPath.
Requirements: Node >= 22 or Bun >= 1.0.0, Homebrew SQLite on macOS; three GGUF models auto-downloaded from HuggingFace to ~/.cache/qmd/models/ (~300 MB, ~640 MB, ~1.1 GB).

Collections are defined in ~/.config/qmd/index.yml: path, pattern (default **/*.md), ignore, update hook, includeByDefault, hierarchical context; built-in exclusions node_modules, .git, .cache, vendor, dist, build.

A checked-in project-local .qmd config is not trusted by default (update commands, out-of-project paths, custom models); with no terminal (agents, CI, MCP) the gated fields are skipped and in-project indexing continues.
Index is a single SQLite file at ~/.cache/qmd/index.sqlite (FTS5 + sqlite-vec); documents are chunked into ~900 tokens with 15% overlap.

readme.telemetry_and_network: No telemetry, analytics or update-check code found in src/ (grep for telemetry/analytics/sentry/posthog/update-notifier; third-party dependencies were not audited). Network use found: (1) Model weights: the three default GGUF models are `hf:` URIs resolved by node-llama-cpp resolveModelFile into ~/.cache/qmd/models on first use of embed/vsearch/query or MCP vec/hyde/rerank (src/llm.ts:279-285, 1098-1105; README.md:556-564); `qmd pull` additionally sends HEAD requests to https://huggingface.co/<repo>/resolve/main/<file> to compare ETags (src/llm.ts:351-361, 516-549); HF_ENDPOINT mirrors are honoured (src/llm.ts:469; src/cli/qmd.ts:3815). (2) node-llama-cpp may compile llama.cpp locally and download its source when no packaged prebuilt binding fits (build 'auto', skipDownload false: src/llm.ts:993-1005). (3) `qmd search`, `get`, `multi-get`, `ls` and `status` read only the local SQLite index and need no models or network (src/cli/qmd.ts:2798-2828, 514-573). (4) MCP stdio opens no socket; MCP HTTP listens on localhost:8181 by default with Origin/Host checks and no authentication (src/mcp/server.ts:939-971, 1108-1112). (5) Per-collection `update:` hooks run `bash -c <command>` (for example git pull) before `qmd update` (src/cli/qmd.ts:935-967). No account, API key or hosted service is required.

code.architecture: Single ESM TypeScript package (~18.5k lines in src/). src/store.ts (~6.1k lines) is the core: schema (content table keyed by SHA-256, documents mapping collection/path to hash, documents_fts FTS5, content_vectors + sqlite-vec vectors_vec, llm_cache, store_collections; :1181-1283), reindexCollection (fast-glob + UTF-8 read, :1605-1725), markdown break-point chunking (900 tokens, 15% overlap), searchFTS (BM25), searchVec, reciprocalRankFusion, hybridQuery (BM25 probe, LLM expansion, RRF, chunk rerank, position-aware blend), structuredSearch (caller-typed lex/vec/hyde), and findDocument/getDocumentBody/findDocuments (all read the stored copy). src/llm.ts (~2.2k lines) wraps node-llama-cpp: lazy model load, GPU/CPU selection, embeddings, rerank via ranking context rankAll, grammar-constrained query expansion, idle unload. src/db.ts abstracts bun:sqlite vs better-sqlite3 and loads sqlite-vec. src/collections.ts handles YAML config and project-local .qmd discovery; src/trust.ts is the approval gate for project-local config; src/index.ts is the SDK facade; src/mcp/server.ts and src/mcp/origin-guard.ts are the MCP server and DNS-rebinding guard; src/cli/ holds formatter, version, MCP PID and embed-lock helpers; src/ast.ts does tree-sitter chunking for code files; src/maintenance.ts does cleanup. Index selection: --index <name>, else the nearest .qmd/index.yml|yaml found walking up from cwd (project-local .qmd/index.sqlite), else global ~/.cache/qmd/index.sqlite with ~/.config/qmd/index.yml (src/cli/qmd.ts:3090-3106; src/collections.ts:112-154; src/store.ts:636-654). Default models: embeddinggemma-300M (embed), Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B (rerank), fine-tuned Qwen3-1.7B qmd-query-expansion (generate) (src/llm.ts:282-285).
code.packaging_and_release: Artifact: npm package @tobilu/qmd; package.json `files` ships bin/, dist/, skills/, four scripts, LICENSE and CHANGELOG.md (package.json:17-27); dist/ is built by scripts/build.mjs (tsc -p tsconfig.build.json, stamps dist/cli/build-info.json with the commit). Release flow: scripts/release.sh renames CHANGELOG [Unreleased], bumps package.json and .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, commits 'release: vX' and tags vX (scripts/release.sh:96-124); scripts/pre-push validates tag/version/changelog/CI (scripts/pre-push:13-90). .github/workflows/publish.yml runs on tags v*: bun install --frozen-lockfile, bun test, npm run build, `npm publish --provenance --access public` (permissions id-token: write, so an npm provenance attestation), then `gh release create` with notes from CHANGELOG (publish.yml:3-56). No prebuilt binaries, checksums or detached signatures are produced; npm provenance is the only attestation. The release workflow uses bun-version: latest (publish.yml:18-20). Nix: flake.nix builds from source with fixed-output node_modules hashes for x86_64-linux and aarch64-darwin; aarch64-linux and x86_64-darwin are fakeHash placeholders (flake.nix:46-53). The v2.8.3 tag is annotated and peels to facd35e (.git/packed-refs:2-3); CHANGELOG dates 2.8.3 as 2026-08-16 (CHANGELOG.md:5).

risks: Scope gap for document conversion: ingestion is fast-glob plus readFileSync(utf-8) on any file matching the mask (default **/*.md) with no binary-file or size guard (src/store.ts:1623-1677); nothing in src/ or package.json handles PDF, scans/OCR, Office, EPUB or HTML. A mask that matches binary files would index mangled text, and title extraction exists only for .md and .org (src/store.ts:2866-2896). Any conversion to Markdown must happen outside QMD; CHANGELOG.md:896-898 mentions 'PDF ingestion' only as a source of long chunks.

Read-back returns an indexed snapshot, not the live file: get/multi_get read the SQLite content table written at the last `qmd update` (src/store.ts:1661-1706, 4884-4928, 5056-5154); the MCP server never re-indexes (no update call in src/mcp/server.ts), so edits stay invisible until `qmd update` (and vectors until `qmd embed`). docid is only the first 6 hex chars of the SHA-256 body hash, identical files share it, and docid or path-suffix lookups return the first match (src/store.ts:3363-3384, 4817-4825); `multi_get` compares maxBytes against SQLite LENGTH of text (src/store.ts:5127).

Vector and hybrid search depend on three GGUF models (~2 GB) fetched from Hugging Face on first use via mutable resolve/main refs, checked only by GGUF magic bytes and ETag, with no pinned digest (src/llm.ts:279-285, 351-361, 453-482); `qmd vsearch` also runs the 1.7B expansion model (src/store.ts:5783); the MCP `query` tool defaults to rerank=true (src/mcp/server.ts:334). Any truthy CI environment variable (even 'false') makes embedBatch, generate, expandQuery and rerank throw (src/llm.ts:804, 1475, 1542, 1603, 1710). `qmd pull` deletes cached model files when the remote ETag cannot be fetched, before attempting a re-download (src/llm.ts:516-531). The native stack (node-llama-cpp 3.20.0, better-sqlite3, sqlite-vec 0.1.9) is ABI-sensitive (bin/qmd:124-172) and node-llama-cpp may try to compile llama.cpp (src/llm.ts:993-1005).

Trust and exposure: the project-local .qmd/index.yml approval gate is enforced only in CLI commands (src/cli/qmd.ts:895-967, 4637, 4661, 4701, 4711); the MCP/SDK path (src/mcp/server.ts:800-865, src/index.ts:352-391) never calls src/trust.ts and passes models.* from an adopted local config straight to LlamaCpp, contrary to README.md:821-824. The HTTP transport is unauthenticated; only Origin/Host checks exist and --host 0.0.0.0 disables the Host check (src/mcp/server.ts:1108-1112; README.md:175-178). Which index an MCP server uses depends on the launching client's cwd (local .qmd found upward from cwd, src/cli/qmd.ts:3090-3106). The MCP instructions string puts collection names and global context into the client's system prompt (src/mcp/server.ts:107-163).

Client coverage: only Claude clients are documented (Claude Desktop JSON, Claude Code plugin/skill; README.md:99-130; .claude-plugin/marketplace.json). No Codex-specific documentation, config snippet or code exists ('codex' appears only as a sample collection name, example-index.yml:90); OpenClaw appears in skills/qmd/references/mcp-setup.md:31-40 and a .pi/settings.json skills pointer exists. `qmd skill install` writes to ./.agents/skills/qmd (src/cli/qmd.ts:3158-3168). The Claude plugin does not install the qmd binary (skills/qmd/SKILL.md:5).

Documentation drift that can mislead agents: README says MCP `searches` is required and multi_get maxBytes defaults to 10240 (README.md:188, 200) but code accepts plain `query` or `searches` and defaults to 65536 (src/mcp/server.ts:317-324, 490; src/store.ts:94); skills/qmd/references/mcp-setup.md documents get params `path`/`full` and a singular `collection` that the code lacks (mcp-setup.md:73-109 vs src/mcp/server.ts:330, 410-415); multi_get's skip message names a nonexistent tool 'qmd_get' (src/mcp/server.ts:514); `qmd update [--pull]` in --help has no implementation (src/cli/qmd.ts:3593; option parsed at :3058, never read); README says tree-sitter grammars are optional but they are required dependencies (README.md:673-675 vs package.json:65-68, test/package.test.ts:35-40). Unknown MCP parameters are silently ignored (README.md:204).

Maintenance and supply chain: no security policy file and no dependabot/renovate; the release workflow installs bun-version: latest on one ubuntu job (publish.yml:18-20) and npm provenance is the only attestation (no checksums or signatures); CI skips all model-backed and live-HTTP suites (see tests_and_ci); sqlite-vec is pre-1.0 (0.1.9) and the LLM/native stack is exact-pinned, needing manual bumps (skills/release/SKILL.md:32-36); the Nix flake has fakeHash placeholders for aarch64-linux and x86_64-darwin (flake.nix:50-53) and CHANGELOG.md:49 notes flake hashes were not updated with a dependency bump; CHANGELOG has no 2.7.x or 2.8.0-2.8.2 headers, and the 2.8.3 entry spans ~390 lines (CHANGELOG.md:5-392).

Licensing: the code is MIT (LICENSE:1-21; package.json:120), but the three downloaded model weights carry their own licences, which this repo does not state (README.md:556-564); the default embedder is a Google EmbeddingGemma GGUF whose terms are outside this repo. finetune/README.md:1-12 declares MIT for the fine-tuned expansion model (base Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B).
